name: Desk Terminal, Wired
tagline: One cased terminal wired into the family's desk: Home's glass says 'Give Vera something to plan.', a lit lead runs to Coming up's NOW lamp, every dated list leads with one day numeral, and each band has exactly one light.
concept: The same cased terminal stands at the left of the desk on every page (6px case, 2px bezel), and a lit patch lead runs from a socket on the case to Coming up's white-hot NOW lamp. Home's glass shows the scrollback: 'Vera, Friday 2 October', Next up in inverse VT323 beside a small radar, then 'Give Vera something to plan.' in bone. Only 'plan.' is white-hot, followed by the site's one block cursor. The page is built on a few rules. Every dated list leads with a day numeral, and the next plan's numeral carries one lit mark wherever it appears. Every list hangs from a steel rail whose stops are lamps. Each band has exactly one light. The tube light glows at full strength on the glass, the dial, the lead and the lamps; the desk around it stays calm and in grounded colours.
companions: Wheat (#d8c38a), now 3px: the cap over every band, the left edge of Finish setting up, and the cap of the phone's closing foot. Grounded kind inks, used only in the ring and the kind word: clay for restaurants, straw for activities, moss for outings, dusk for trips and day trips, heather for shows, events and other, clay-orange for seasonal. The ways to start take the ink of where they usually land: dusk for Plans, straw for To do, heather for Ideas. Heather is also the dashed open stop 'Add an idea'. Dusk: the month word beside each day numeral. Dim: the weekday under it. Bone: the family's words and unlit numerals. Steel: rails and stops, now drawn through Lately added's rings. Graphite with a phosphor LED and underline marks 'here'; the steel slab is gone. Pewter: upcoming and off lamps. Sage: hover and a ticked box. Muted rose (#c39aa8): wishes. Amber: only late and 'needs a look'. Denim: links.
decisions: Built from the design's own build.py: the themed base, then palette.css, with spaces outside strings stripped. The sheet is 180.8k of the 200k budget, after deleting the Status contents scroll-spy block.

Title: put back 'Give Vera something to plan.', the line the cross lessons give to Desk alone. 'to plan.' is held on one line, so the lit word never sits alone. The lit run is color-mix(screen 30%, #fff) under the E1 halo (0 0 .06em #fff, 0 0 .35em screen, 0 0 1em rgb(109 255 156/.45)).

The cursor is the site's only one. It blinks 8 times, then holds. Its off phase falls to a 50% afterglow instead of disappearing (its own keyframe, afterglow-blink), so a still or a glance always finds it. That fixed it vanishing on home-phone. The wordmark's caret is removed from base.html, so no other page shows a cursor.

One day mark: Coming up's NOW-row numeral and every future plan day in the month share one rule: --screen ink, a tight E1 halo, and a 1px phosphor underline (text-decoration, so it sits under the figures themselves). Past plan days get a steel underbar. Rows 2-4 stay bone. Beside each numeral, the month is Plex Sans 500 at 0.75rem in dusk and the weekday is in dim.

The dial's day numerals are 22 units (about 20px on the 15rem glass). The sweep wedge's leading edge now stops 12deg short of its target, not the 4 the brief named: at 4deg the wedge's width still touched the '4' label.

Two label kinds, as one rule. A label names a control or a group (label, .keys-name, .plate-name): sentence case, Plex Sans 500, --fs-small, --label, no tracking. A column head over figures (.data th, month th, colheads, eyebrows) stays Plex Mono caps, tracked, as the machine's own. The deck's 'From' is now the rule, not an exception.

Lately added: the steel rail is now drawn through both columns (row position:relative, rings above the line). The right column ends in the rail's open stop, a dashed heather ring with 'Add an idea' and 'or tell Vera one', so the columns are 3 and 3 and the head drops its duplicate '+ Add an idea'.

Phone order with no CSS reordering: the case's two-line foot (Ready, then the wishes) is drawn twice from one macro: in the case on a wide screen, and as .phone-foot closing the page on a phone. One copy is always display:none, so a screen reader meets it once. Ways to start are 44px rows on the phone. Coming up's first row now sits at 831px on a 390x844 phone, inside the first screen (it was about 2 screens down).
The 'Where I am' toggle's accessible name is now aria-label 'Send where I am'. The visible caption is aria-hidden, 0.8125rem on desktop, and hidden on the phone, so the From row is one 44px line.
Bar: the desktop current key keeps its graphite face and its 12px phosphor underline. The 4px dot under it now appears only on the phone tab bar, which has no face.
Settings and the form: the Ready chip sits flush right at the panel's edge (margin-left:auto in a head row capped at the panel's 62rem), the same on every folded page.
Status: removed the scroll-driven 'in view' latch that lit every band on screen (two at once at the top). The Contents plate now has no false 'here' state.
Month chips: clamped to 2 lines with the full title in a title attribute. The clamp's link padding is zeroed so no third line bleeds under the time, and the time keeps its own line.
Home's green share went from 65.3% to 60.3% with no lost light. Wheat caps and the setup edge went to 3px, and Send's side padding is a little tighter.
title: *plan.*: 'Give Vera *plan.*' is wrong; exactly: "Give Vera something to *plan.*". It names who hears you, and 'something' takes in plans, reminders, ideas and wishes, which is FamilyDB's job: the family hands things to Vera and she plans them.
measures: Final full render: 0 hard checks failed, 1 guideline missed. ink_on_bg 12.49, brand_on_bg 15.18, glow, screenGlow and topGlow 1.0. Home: green share 60.3% (was 65.3%), hue entropy 0.549, coloured share 2.36%, other-colour neon share 5.8%. Ideas: green 74.2%, entropy 0.396 (the map glass). Chat: 72.7%. Status: 42.8%. Smallest text is 12px (Home's month word 'Oct'). No sideways scroll. The one WARN is 'page's words unchanged' (plans, 44.3% of words differ), which is expected for this design. Phone: Coming up's first row at y=831 on 390x844, To do at 1360, Lately added at 1738, the closing foot at 2139. Tab on Home goes from the bar to the textarea, then the select, toggle, mic and Send. The harness lists the toggle as 'input: 1' because it reads the value; its accessible name is 'Send where I am'.
strengths: It is clearly the same machine as Patched: the cased terminal, the patch lead into the white-hot NOW lamp, the rails whose stops are controls, and the four tubes.
The day numeral is now one mark: the lit '4' in Coming up's NOW row, the dial's lit ticks and the month's plan days use the same ink, halo and underbar.
One label system across Plans, To do, Ideas, Status, Chat and the forms. Mono caps are kept only for column heads.
The phone puts the next plan inside the first screen without reordering anything. The foot closes the page instead of standing between the box and Coming up.
Lately added has two balanced columns, each on a drawn steel rail, ending in an open stop that invites the next idea. It has one lit lamp ('newest').
The glass keeps the lineage's title and its heat. The cursor never disappears in a still, and it is the only one on the site.
weaknesses: The month chips still share one dusk edge. The month route gives entries no idea kind, and I can only change templates, so the kind graft stops at the grid.
The 2-line clamp cuts plan names in the month ('Mount St. Helens d…', 'Nutcracker at the…'). The full name is only a hover title away.
Home's green share is 60.3%, just over the 60% target. Ideas (74%) and Chat (73%) stay greener because their glasses are large.
Status no longer shows which band you are reading. The double latch is gone, but no single 'here' replaced it.
The phone's closing foot is inset a few pixels from the full-bleed bands above it.
On desktop the toggle's 'Where I am' caption still makes the From row taller than the keys beside it.
revisions: Title restored to 'Give Vera something to plan.' with the lit run on 'plan.'. The halo is set to the critic's exact E1 values over the hot core.
The cursor now has an afterglow blink (8 blinks, then holds, never invisible) and shows on home-phone. The wordmark caret is removed everywhere, so the cursor is Home's alone.

Phone: the case foot (Ready plus wishes) closes the page through a second copy of the same macro, one copy always hidden. Ways to start are 44px with tighter padding, the empty #where line is hidden, and the 'Where I am' caption is hidden. Coming up row one is at 831px.
Toggle: aria-label 'Send where I am', the visible caption is aria-hidden, and it is 0.8125rem on desktop.

Numeral law: the NOW row's numeral takes the month's lit mark (screen, tight halo, 1px underbar), now one shared rule. Month and weekday are Plex 500 0.75rem, the month in dusk and the weekday in dim. The dial's day numerals went up to 22 units. The sweep wedge stops 12deg short (declined the brief's 4deg because it still touched the '4' label).
Labels: one rule for label, .keys-name and .plate-name (sentence case, Plex Sans 500, --fs-small, --label, untracked). Column heads stay mono caps.

Lately added: the steel rails are drawn through the rings. The right column is balanced 3 and 3 with an 'Add an idea' open stop, and the head's duplicate link is gone. I did not add idea #5: the route sends only these ideas, and an invented row would misstate the data.
Bar: the 4px dot is dropped on desktop and kept on the phone tab bar.
Form and Settings: the Ready chip sits flush right at the panel edge on both.
Status: removed the scroll-driven double 'here' highlight.
Month: chips clamped to 2 lines (with a title attribute), and the time stays on its own line.

Declined: per-kind left edges on month chips. The month template gets no kind for a plan (agenda entries have none) and the route cannot be changed, so guessing a kind from title words would be a guess dressed as data.
Green share brought from 65.3% to 60.3% with 3px wheat caps and setup edge and a tighter Send. I did not dim the primary or the glass to get under 60%.
crit: HOME glass title (templates/home.html line 54, .ask-question): the designer changed the title to 'Anything for Vera to plan?'. That is a question form the cross lessons retire, and it gives up the title the lessons assign to Desk alone ('Give Vera something to plan.', its 7.95 setting). The lit run has also lost its heat: 'plan?' reads as pale bone next to the parent's white-hot 'plan.'. Restore 'Give Vera something to plan.' with the lit run on 'plan.'. Strengthen .ask-question .glow (sheet.css ~3123) back to the E1 two-layer halo over a hot core: color-mix(in srgb,var(--screen) 30%,#fff), text-shadow 0 0 .06em #fff, 0 0 .35em var(--screen), 0 0 1em rgb(109 255 156/.45). The caret is missing on home-phone: the .crt-cursor after the label must not be hidden or wrapped away at 390px, since it is the one cursor on the site.

HOME-PHONE order: at 390×844 Coming up's first row falls about 2 screens down, because the whole .terminal-foot (Ready plus wishes) and the three 48px ways-to-start rows sit between the deck and Coming up. At <=640px, move .terminal-foot after Lately added (grid order, or put the wishes line at the very end per the brief's phone order), and drop the ways-to-start rows to 44px with tighter top padding, so Coming up starts within 1.5 screens. Check the deck too: the bare 'Where I am' caption under the toggle makes the From row two lines tall. Put it in the toggle's aria-label on the phone, so the row is one 44px line.

THE NUMERAL LAW is not one mark yet. On Home, Coming up's numerals (4, 9, 17, 24) are unlit light-weight bone, while the dial and the month light the same figures in --screen with an underbar. Give the NOW row's numeral (the '4' where the lead lands) the same lit mark as the dial and month (--screen, 1px phosphor underbar, tight E1 halo), and leave rows 2-4 bone. The stacked 'Oct / Sun' VT323 beside each numeral is about 11px and grey. Set it in Plex 500 at 0.75rem: the month in --dusk (the brief says month names are dusk) and the weekday in --dim. On Plans, the dial's day numerals still read about 14px; set .dial-day at 1rem or more as the brief says. The sweep wedge still touches the lit '4' tick at 12 o'clock; stop it 4deg short.

LABELS have two systems. The deck's 'From' is now sentence-case Plex 500, but every other control label is still tracked uppercase mono: VIEW and MONTH (Plans), SHOW and SEARCH (To do), KIND, FOR and STATUS (Ideas), ON THIS PAGE (Status), CONVERSATIONS (Chat), and TITLE, KIND, SUGGESTED BY and DESCRIPTION on the form. Make one rule in the label class used by .terminal and form labels: sentence case, Plex Sans 500, --fs-small, --label, no letter-spacing. Then the From change is a law, not an exception.

LATELY ADDED balance and rails: the right column holds only Cannon Beach and 'Something to eat', so it ends one row short of the left, the same ragged foot judges marked before. Split 3/3 by letting 'Something to eat' (the restaurants group) close the right column under a 'See them' link and adding idea #5 (Mount St. Helens, dusk Day trip), or flow columns with column-fill:balance. The steel rails each column was meant to hang from are invisible; draw the 1px steel rail through the kind rings, as on the ways to start, so the band shares the desk's 'every list hangs from a rail' grammar.

PLANS month chips: every chip uses one dusk left edge, so the kind graft stops at the grid. Pass the plan's idea kind into plans_month.html (a data-kind on .plan-chip, from plan.idea.kind or the idea lookup the list view already uses) and map it to --clay/--straw/--moss/--dusk/--heather like the Ideas list. Long names wrap to 3 lines ('Mount St. Helens day trip'). Cap chip titles at 2 lines with line-clamp and keep the time on its own VT323 line.

WORDMARK and HERE marks: the block cursor after 'FamilyDB' shows on Home and Status but not on Plans, To do, Ideas, Chat, Settings or the form. The brief says the cursor appears only on Home's glass, so remove it from the wordmark everywhere (or keep it on every page, but not on two). In the bar, the current key now carries a graphite face, a 2px phosphor underline and a 4px dot under it: three marks for one state. Drop the dot under the bar key (keep it only on the phone's tab bar, where there is no graphite face). The terminal keys' right-hand LED already is their dot, so their underline can stay.

FORM and SETTINGS heads: on the New idea form the 'Ready' chip floats at about x 760, detached from both the subtitle and the right edge of the 1024px panel. Seat it right after the subtitle as on Settings, or flush right to the panel's edge, and do the same on every form. On Status the contents rail highlights rows 1 and 2 both (two steel-tinted rows), which reads as two 'here' states; keep one. Fix the toggle's accessible name: 'Send Where I am' (the health text shows it, and the focus order reads it as 'input: 1'). Give it aria-label 'Send where I am' and take the visible caption out of the name, and raise .loc-word from 12px to at least 0.8125rem.

firstDraft.name: Desk Terminal, Wired
firstDraft.concept: This is the same cased terminal at the left of every page, now wired into the family's desk. A lit lead runs from a socket on the case to Coming up's NOW lamp, and a bright pulse runs along it from the socket once the tube has warmed up. Every dated list leads with one day numeral, which is also used on the Plans dial and in the month grid. Every list hangs from a rail whose stops are lamps, with the square tick box beside each one. Each band has exactly one light. The phosphor glows at full strength on the glass, the dial, the lead and the lamps, while the desk around it stays calm and in grounded colours.
